items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: Morrison wanted to go over and play a dinner dance... So, we saw... I'd make one at 12, and then I'd go back at 5 and make one. But I played two concerts a day in my repair department.

ctx.x: And here's dance. Grand opening Saturday, June 9th, Eaton's Club, Henderson Point, Pass, Christian. That would be true.
We have skipped a clutter area there. Yeah. These are late things, huh? Yeah. He skipped quite a while during the compression when he was playing at Morrison's interview. Oh, yeah.
Well, that's... Yeah. Then let me go back a little while to Morrison's end. When did you play at Morrison's?
